svg.title: SvelteKit and Hono Lambdaliths
svg.desc: A user calls the SvelteKit frontend's function URL; its server calls the Hono backend's function URL, which keeps the click count in an Upstash Redis database hosted in Upstash's own AWS account in the same Region. Both functions run their web servers through the Lambda Web Adapter.

text.font-family: Consolas, Menlo, DejaVu Sans Mono, Liberation Mono, monospace
